en.headline: Hong Kong labour shortfall cut to 130,000 by 2028, Sun says
en.dek: The labour chief said a mid-term manpower update points to a smaller gap than the 180,000 projected two years ago, citing talent schemes and rapid AI adoption.
body: Hong Kong is expected to be short of about 130,000 workers by 2028, 50,000 fewer than officials projected two years ago, Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun Yuk-han said on Thursday.

Speaking at a briefing on the first five-year plan and the Policy Address, Sun said the government had completed a mid-term update of its manpower projection and would publish the details next week. He attributed the narrower gap to changes in the economic structure, the effect of talent and labour-importation policies, and the rapid development of artificial intelligence over the past one to two years. Without those policies, he said, the 2028 shortfall could have reached 300,000.

Sun also outlined a Graduate Employment Kick-start Scheme under the wider youth jobs package. The Labour and Welfare Bureau, working with six major chambers of commerce, aims to create 10,000 additional full-time posts over 2027 and 2028, each lasting at least six months. The government will subsidise one-third of each hire's salary, capped at HK$6,000 a month. The places will be open to Hong Kong permanent residents aged 29 or under.

He said the Talent List, which now covers 60 professions, would continue to be updated, with a focus on adding more AI-related occupations tied to national development priorities. Founders admitted under the Top Talent Pass Scheme will also be exempted from having to show company income when renewing their visas, he said.

zh.headline: 孫玉菏：2028年人力短缺收窄至約13萬人
zh.dek: 勞福局局長表示，中期人力推算顯示缺口較兩年前估計的18萬人減少5萬，歸因於人才政策及人工智能發展。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菏周四表示，本港到2028年整體人力短缺預計約為13萬人，較兩年前推算的18萬人減少5萬人。
他在解說五年規劃及施政報告的記者會上指出，當局近日完成人力推算中期更新，詳情將於下周公布。短缺收窄反映經濟結構變化、人才及輸入勞工政策的成效，以及過去一兩年人工智能迅速發展對人力需求的影響。他強調，若沒有相關政策介入，2028年缺口或達30萬人。
孫玉菏同時交代「畢業生就業啟航計劃」。勞福局聯同六大商會，目標在2027及2028年創造合共1萬個額外全職職位，每份工作為期至少六個月，政府承擔僱員薪金三分之一，上限每月6,000港元。計劃只開放予29歲或以下的香港永久性居民。
他表示會持續更新現時涵蓋60個專業的人才清單，下一輪檢討會聚焦加入更多與人工智能相關的工種。獲高才通計劃批准的初創創辦人，續簽時亦毋須再提交公司收入證明。
